name: Love Bites! Howloween Special
source:
You play as Gabe, a werewolf who plans to celebrate Howloween (no, that's not a typo) with your boyfriend Luka. However, things take a dark and mysterious turn when you go to what was supposed to be a party and end up fighting for your life at a strange house. Will you survive? Will you do anything to protect the ones you love?

[From [url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/love-bites-howloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演狼人加布（Gabe），计划与你的男朋友卢卡（Luka）一起庆祝豪洛温（不，这不是错字）。然而，当你去参加一个本来应该举行的聚会并最终在一所陌生的房子里为自己的生命而战时，事情发生了黑暗和神秘的转变。你能活下来吗？你会做任何事情来保护你所爱的人吗？

[来自[url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/love-bites-howloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
